title: HyperFormer generator outputs Mirror codes
hypothesis: For an adapter bank with 18 observed and six withheld task×layer combinations, a HyperFormer-style generator that emits a two-dimensional code and decodes it through a shared matrix basis will reach withheld-combination output RMSE <=0.05 at <=0.75x the actual bytes and <=0.75x generator compute of a matched full-adapter hypernetwork; direct native low-rank code generation tests whether the gain is Mirror-specific.
physical_object: shared frozen 4x4 base matrix, shared rank-two adapter basis, and task/layer embedding tables
mirror_coordinate: two learned coefficients emitted from concatenated task and layer embeddings, decoded into a 4x4 adapter update
logical_multiplicity: 24 task×layer adapters generated from one shared basis and compact codes
controls: HyperFormer-style two-layer MLP generator directly emits all 16 adapter values
same two-dimensional code generator plus shared adapter basis named native low-rank generator (exact map control)
independent per-pair matrices trained only on the 18 observed pairs as a seen-pair fit/storage reference; no audit values are fit

task.type: synthetic 4D linear adapter generation; 6 task identities × 4 layer positions, with smooth rank-two teacher updates
task.heldout_pair_rule: the complementary 6 Cartesian pairs; every task and layer identity appears in training
task.teacher: rank-two adapter update with coefficients smooth in numeric task and layer identities

development.selection_metric: output RMSE averaged across the six heldout task×layer pairs; also report seen-pair RMSE, actual payload bytes, MAC proxy, query wall and per-pair scores

compute.inference_mac_proxy: direct generator: 4×16 + 16×16 + 16 output + 16 base application; Mirror: 4×16 + 16×2 + 2×16 basis decode + 16 application + 16 base application
compute.query_timing_boundary: Generate one adapter per heldout task×layer pair, then evaluate 256 input examples; startup and query are timed together.

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds: heldout RMSE <=0.05 and <=1.10x HyperFormer RMSE; Mirror actual payload <=0.75x HyperFormer bytes; Mirror MAC proxy <=0.75x HyperFormer; and native low-rank control does not exactly match Mirror payload/output.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses a PROMISING gate, the native low-rank generator exactly aliases Mirror, or the seen-pair independent table has lower training error at no more than 1.25x Mirror bytes (reported only as a seen-pair reference).
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: HyperFormer heldout RMSE >0.05 on either seed or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Mechanism screen on a synthetic rank-two adapter family; no language-model quality claim.
The independent table is a seen-pair fit only; it is not a fair heldout-combination predictor.
Shared task/layer embedding tables are learned and paid; all combinations use the same identity tables.
Fixed-update learning signal is not a capacity claim; no near-convergence claim.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless every frozen PROMISING gate passes.
